definition.title: The Broken Relay
definition.briefing: K-7 has a fixed repair party and no resource budget. Thornblades cover the relay. Defeat the two marked blockers, then move K-7 to the relay pad while the Prism Archers keep their distance.
definition.successText: The relay records a request from a disconnected foundry. K-7 follows it rather than the old command to abandon damaged units.
definition.failureText: K-7 or both Prism Archers are lost. Reset the relay party and keep the archers behind the Sentinels.

objectives.text: Defeat both marked blockers and bring K-7 to the relay pad at (29, 18).
Keep Unit K-7 alive. The army and zero-resource budget are fixed; reset restores this starting position.

definition.title: The Obsolete Command
definition.briefing: K-7 enters the survey depot to recover the order that cut power to the foundry. Follow the western road, reach the northern archive, and return to Assembler M-2 without two alarms.
definition.successText: The order came from the Null Architect. K-7 chooses whether to defend the disconnected foundry or escort M-2 through the repair route.
definition.failureText: K-7 is destroyed or identified twice. Reset the survey-depot approach.

objectives.text: Reach the marked archive at (30, 6) without two alarms.
Return Unit K-7 to (6, 29) with the archive. Move around guard sight cones; fighting is optional.

definition.title: The Repair Route
definition.briefing: K-7 follows Assembler M-2 along the old repair route. Stay beside M-2, keep Sentinels in front when the harbor guards arrive, and restore a damaged ally with K-7's Prime Shield before crossing the final wet span.
definition.successText: M-2 reaches the independent relay and reconnects the foundry remotely. K-7 advances through the service entrance to the Null Architect.
definition.failureText: M-2 or K-7 is lost on the repair route. Reset and move the formation beside the assembler.

objectives.text: Escort convoy through all 3 checkpoints. Keep troops within seven tiles so the convoy advances.
Keep Unit K-7 alive until the convoy arrives.

definition.title: The Null Architect
definition.briefing: The Null Architect is dismantling the independent relay. Use the Ward Engine to restore shields and K-7's Prime Shield to reinforce a threatened machine. Spread the shield line around warning circles and interrupt the purge with Prism Archer fire.
definition.successText: The Architect is defeated. K-7 keeps the foundry connected and removes the command that marked its damaged workers expendable.
definition.failureText: K-7 is destroyed and the independent relay falls. Reset the final formation.

objectives.text: Defeat Null Architect. Survive all three phases and move out of a warning circle or interrupt it with concentrated fire.
Dodge or interrupt at least one telegraphed attack.
